mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates and increases equity valuations, leading to positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% in a 3-month window signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5%

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, triggering negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 95 during a manufacturing slowdown regime indicates contraction in output, leading to negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95

mechanism_narrative: A rising GDP growth rate (GDPC1) reflects expanding economic activity, increasing corporate profits and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth is positive

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% triggers monetary tightening expectations, causing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in payrolls (PAYEMS) signal labor market stress, resulting in negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when both PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates economic weakness, causing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and INDPRO declines
